selections.rationale: One test-only correction; preserve r3 specification/reference/mutant bytes. Test valid external ticket/root state with hidden required title/details and nextId; toggle/delete preserve required fields and unchanged ticket identities. No arbitrary-extra copying or new deep-clone guarantee.

One test-only correction; preserve r3 specification/reference/mutant bytes. Test sparse own holes on an array with a local Array-derived prototype holding index0:7. Mapper and fallback receive undefined. Do not mutate global Array.prototype or demand unspecified callback-driven length behavior.

One test-only correction; preserve r3 specification/reference/mutant bytes. A nonempty spaces-only failure message is valid and retained exactly with detached values/saved state. Preserve the separate trim-based save-start name rule.

One test-only correction; preserve r3 specification/reference/mutant bytes. POST and PUT accept spaces-only nonempty text and preserve it exactly. Preserve absent-PUT-before-body-validation ordering and exact routes/methods; do not treat empty string as valid.

One test-only correction; preserve r3 specification/reference/mutant bytes. Both on/off require a function handler, including rejecting omitted/explicit undefined. Preserve idempotent Set-like same-function registration and arbitrary publish payload; do not impose independent duplicate registrations here.

One test-only correction; preserve r3 specification/reference/mutant bytes. Test same-function registrations A,B,A; unsubscribe last A, then emit, expecting A,B. Independently test hidden required typed fields in loader input, mapped output and filter input. Keep transactional errors and per-listener filter copies; do not clone unspecified extras.

One test-only correction; preserve r3 specification/reference/mutant bytes. Register A,B,A and unsubscribe last A twice, then supported toggle/set emits to A,B. Keep repeated-set delivery, distinct frozen snapshots and omitted/default versus explicitly undefined constructor values; no invented setter input domain.

One test-only correction; preserve r3 specification/reference/mutant bytes. Test A,B,A removal after discarding required immediate subscription callbacks. Test terminal LF,CR,CRLF,U+2028,U+2029 amount rejection at zero and nonzero decimals. Identifier validation requires rejection but does not mandate RangeError: remove unsupported identifier-subtype assertions. Retain explicitly required malformed-amount RangeError and nonstring-amount TypeError. No immediate-callback rollback invention.

One test-only correction; preserve r3 specification/reference/mutant bytes. Test A,B,A unsubscribe-last notification order. Remove unpromised per-listener event isolation: an event must be detached from internal state, not necessarily copied independently for each listener. Blank labels require rejection without an unspecified exception subtype; preserve explicitly required ID RangeError. Keep committed-state-on-listener-error, snapshot membership and ordered mutations.

One test-only correction; preserve r3 specification/reference/mutant bytes. Fix strict TypeScript nullable-match narrowing in the test itself. Test /:__proto__ capturing /value as an own property with exact value. Also constructor/toString parameters. Do not require a particular params prototype or URL decoding.

One test-only correction; preserve r3 specification/reference/mutant bytes. Test escaped ordinary text in unknown, malformed (route lacking an unescaped separator), and incomplete marker fallback. Unescape once, never reinterpret escaped delimiters as new markers. Test doubled/trailing backslashes and adjacency.
